title: Abbey Brunies at the halfway house and the Owls
summary: Abbey played the halfway house, and he rates the white Owls band very highly.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Cabarets, honky-tonks and the Storyville nightlife scene

blocks.x: Did you go out and hear, uh, Abbey much when he was here?

Yeah, Abbey used to play at the halfway house out here by, where, you know where the police station used to be? Right across, they had a place called the Budweiser. The Owls, incidentally, played there, too. Oh, they had a group out there when the Owls, Pinky was in that group. Oh, they had a band out there that would really knock it. Hold up, man. That's one of the best band, groups I ever heard in New Orleans. White, white boys, you know. Outside of Shorty's, Kings of Dixieland, I think they were stacked up with those boys.
Oh, well, the records by the Owls, I loved it. Yeah.
